description: This file defines function prototypes and constants for text typography operations in a graphics or UI framework, including rendering text, setting font, font size, alignment, and loading fonts. It appears to be part of a binding or interface layer to Lua, providing functions callable from Lua scripts.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Draws text on the screen at specified coordinates, with the string provided as an argument.

methods.name: textFont
methods.description: Sets the font family for subsequent text rendering, taking a font value returned from loadFont.

methods.name: loadFont
methods.description: Loads a font from a specified path, returning a font reference for use with textFont.

methods.name: textSize
methods.description: Sets the font size in pixels for subsequent text rendering.

methods.name: textAlign
methods.description: Sets the alignment mode for text rendering: CENTER, LEFT, or RIGHT.
